title: Trump's Midas curse: Why his golden picks turned blue in US midterms 2026
content: Donald Trump's endorsement of numerous candidates in the 2026 midterms proved less effective than anticipated, leading to notable electoral disappointments. Democrats triumphed in Senate and House elections, gaining ground in areas that were once Republican strongholds. The performance of Trump's endorsed candidates reflected a troubling disconnect with voters. Furthermore, Democratic success extended to gubernatorial elections and state legislatures, thereby underscoring an evolving political landscape laden with challenges for the GOP.

title: Guitar mistaken for pillion, turban for bare head: When AI traffic cameras get it wrong
content: AI-powered traffic cameras are increasingly being utilized in India for automated enforcement of traffic rules. However, the technology faces significant challenges resulting in numerous erroneous challans issued to motorists. Incidents include misidentification of objects, such as guitars and turbans, as violations leading to fines. Complaints regarding the accuracy of the system have surged, highlighting accountability issues. As technology evolves, ensuring accuracy is crucial in minimizing errors encountered by drivers.

title: ‘If death is my destiny’: Sheikh Hasina firm on returning to Bangladesh in December

The former Prime Minister is aware of the risks associated with her return, including potential arrest or worse. Hasina's Awami League party has been banned, resulting in widespread political repression and violence against its members. She expressed concerns over the rising influence of extremist groups in the current political climate.

title: Meta has ‘extraordinary’ targets for Mark Zuckerberg, and shareholders get free stock
content: Meta will give shareholders free Class C shares each time its stock doubles and compounds at least 10% a year, targets the company calls "extraordinary." The non-voting Class C shares let CEO Mark Zuckerberg sell stock without losing control, and help him cover California's Prop 40 billionaire tax. Zuckerberg has committed to stay in California for eight years, while Meta plans to use the shares to fund its AI push.

title: NY woman's dog and cat taken from flat; court revives trespass, distress claims

Nearly three years after the incident, an appeals court allowed her trespass and emotional distress claims to proceed. Court records indicated that her dog was euthanised after spending nearly two months at a shelter.

title: $23bn Trump-class battleship faces political storm as Democrats capture Congress

title: Titanic owners got $5m insurance payout; original document could fetch £67,000

The owners received their payout shortly after the tragedy, contrasting sharply with the delays faced by bereaved families. The piece also underscores the important insurance arrangements for the Titanic, along with a selection of other artifacts that commemorate its storied past.

title: Former Indiana coal mine land: 3,950 acres now protected for wildlife

title: A drug, custom-made in The Hague, for 7 kids in India
content: tiratricol is going to be compounded by Tr­ansvaal Pharmacy for 1.8 euro per capsule . it is 99 times cheaper than the commercial drug sold by the Swedish company Egetis in Germany for 180 euro (over Rs 19,000) per tablet . the family of one of the children is importing the medicine from Germany .

title: US gets another Indian-origin mayor as Nithya Raman wins Los Angeles election
content: nithya Raman defeated incumbent mayor Karen Bass to win the mayoral race . the contest subsequently evolved into a generational and political battle . bass received the backing of much of the city's political establishment .

title: 'Contemplating to appoint a committee': Centre to SC on UGC's equity rules
content: the apex court was hearing a batch of petitions challenging the UGC regulations . the 2026 regulations had already been kept in abeyance by the top court on January 29 . "the government has taken a decision that every student should be taken care of," SG Mehta says .

title: EC announces electoral roll revision in 6 states, UTs; final rolls on Jan 21
content: the election commission announced a special summary revision of electoral rolls in six states and Union territories . the exercise aims to ensure that all eligible citizens are enrolled in the electoral rolls . it will also facilitate advance applications from individuals who will turn 18 and become eligible to vote on April 1, July 1 and October 1 .

title: US midterm fallout: Trump's India envoy Sergio Gor may replace Marco Rubio - report
content: american ambassador to india reportedly circulating for senior positions . he has emerged as a potential candidate for a bigger role during the second half of the president's term . there is also growing speculation among state department official officials .

title: Jantar Mantar violence: SC gives panel 1 month to file report, flags lack of complaints
content: the panel told a bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant that it had issued notices in 149 newspapers inviting complaints about the violence during a march to Parliament on July 20 . however, it received very few complaints, either online or in physical form . it also informed the top court that it has issued another appeal inviting complaints on October 21 .

title: Early Diwali for desi Dems: 4 hold on to seats, fresher Dandiya dances to victory
content: the four surviving Democratic members of the Samosa Caucus were re-elected on Tuesday . one of them has won from the Congressional district that is home to president Trump's mar-a-Lago estate . in a state not exactly known for rolling out the welcome mat to Democrats, Democrat Amish Shah was also enjoying a promising election night .

title: Watch: INDIA bloc stages mock arrest of CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Bengaluru protest
content: video footage from the rally showed party workers enacting the arrest of Gyanesh Kumar . the protest began at 11 am and was scheduled to continue until 2 pm . it was presided over by Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister DK Shivakumar, former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah and KPCC president BK Hariprasad .

title: 'Over a billion of them': Abdul El-Sayed's reply to uncle over marrying an Indian
content: a video of the newly elected senator recalling a humorous family exchange has gone viral . he recalls how one of his uncles from Egypt reacted when he married an Indian . his wife, a practising psychiatrist, was born into an Indian-origin Muslim family .

title: 'Let's face each other head-on. Inside Parliament': Shah's challenge to Rahul Gandhi
content: amit Shah challenged congress leader Rahul Gandhi to debate him in parliament . he asked him to bring his allegations and arguments to the house instead of taking political debate to the streets . the union home minister also accused the Congress of disrupting parliamentary proceedings .
